### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Fix blocking calls for OpenAI conversation

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
Fixes two blocking calls for `openai_conversiation`:
- `httpx` loading SSL certs
- explicitly caching request header data (https://github.com/openai/openai-python/blob/main/src/openai/_base_client.py#L635 / https://github.com/openai/openai-python/blob/main/src/openai/_base_client.py#L1977) during `async_setup_entry` which e.g. reads /etc/os-release on Linux

Unfortunately, I do not know how to write a test for this (if necessary).

Please assign to the 2024.9 beta milestone.
